```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
library(geosphere)

# Step 1: Load visit and centroid data
visit_data <- read_csv("/home/vandana/gender-bias/FINAL_patient_visit_location_datav2.csv")
district_centroids <- read_csv("/home/vandana/gender-bias/district_wise_centroids.csv")

# Step 2: Filter for nephrology and match_method == po_ps_city_state
nephro_po_ps_data <- visit_data %>%
  filter(
    str_to_lower(dept_name) == "nephrology",
    str_to_lower(match_method) == "po_ps_city_state"
  )

# Step 3: Clean and standardize district/state names in centroids
district_centroids_clean <- district_centroids %>%
  rename(final_district = District, final_state = State) %>%
  mutate(
    final_district = str_to_title(str_trim(final_district)),
    final_state = str_to_title(str_trim(final_state))
  )

# Step 4: Clean and standardize district/state names in nephrology data
nephro_clean <- nephro_po_ps_data %>%
  mutate(
    final_state = str_to_title(str_trim(final_state)),
    final_district = str_to_title(str_trim(final_district)),
    final_district = case_when(
      final_state == "Uttar Pradesh" & str_to_lower(final_district) == "ambedkar nagar"      ~ "Ambedkar Nagar",
      final_state == "Uttar Pradesh" & str_to_lower(final_district) == "barabanki"           ~ "Bara Banki",
      final_state == "Uttar Pradesh" & str_to_lower(final_district) == "bareilly"            ~ "Bareilly",
      final_state == "Uttar Pradesh" & str_to_lower(final_district) == "chandauli"           ~ "Chandauli",
      final_state == "Uttar Pradesh" & str_to_lower(final_district) == "gautam buddha nagar" ~ "Gautam Buddha Nagar",
      final_state == "Uttar Pradesh" & str_to_lower(final_district) == "kanpur nagar"        ~ "Kanpur",
      final_state == "Uttar Pradesh" & str_to_lower(final_district) == "kanshiram nagar"     ~ "Kansganj",
      final_state == "Uttar Pradesh" & str_to_lower(final_district) == "kheri"               ~ "Lakhimpur Kheri",
      final_state == "Uttar Pradesh" & str_to_lower(final_district) == "lakhimpur"           ~ "Lakhimpur Kheri",
      final_state == "Uttar Pradesh" & str_to_lower(final_district) == "mahamaya nagar"      ~ "Hathras",
      final_state == "Uttar Pradesh" & str_to_lower(final_district) == "maharajganj"         ~ "Maharajganj",
      final_state == "Uttar Pradesh" & str_to_lower(final_district) == "pratapgarh"          ~ "Pratapgarh",
      final_state == "Uttar Pradesh" & str_to_lower(final_district) == "siddharthnagar"      ~ "Siddharth Nagar",
      TRUE ~ final_district
    )
  )

# Step 5: Join with centroids
nephro_with_coords <- nephro_clean %>%
  left_join(district_centroids_clean, by = c("final_state", "final_district"))

# Step 6: Filter rows with valid coordinates
nephro_coords_clean <- nephro_with_coords %>%
  filter(!is.na(Latitude) & !is.na(Longitude))

# Step 7: Define Lucknow coordinates
lucknow_coords <- c(lon = 80.89706026871404, lat = 26.838233589251466)

# Step 8: Compute Haversine distance from Lucknow
location_table_with_distance <- nephro_coords_clean %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    Distance_km = distHaversine(lucknow_coords, c_across(c(Longitude, Latitude))) / 1000
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Distance_km = round(Distance_km, 2))

# Step 9: Filter unknown genders, years 2010–2020, and summarize
nephro_summary_with_distance <- location_table_with_distance %>%
  mutate(p_gender = str_to_lower(str_trim(p_gender))) %>%
  filter(
    p_gender %in% c("male", "female"),
    v_year >= 2010 & v_year <= 2020
  ) %>%
  group_by(final_state, final_district, v_type, v_year, Distance_km) %>%
  summarise(
    male              = sum(p_gender == "male", na.rm = TRUE),
    female            = sum(p_gender == "female", na.rm = TRUE),
    total_male_female = male + female,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(final_state, final_district, v_type, v_year, Distance_km)


# Step 10: Save final summarized output
write.csv(nephro_summary_with_distance, "/home/vandana/gender-bias/nephro_summary_with_distance.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r female-visits-plot, fig.cap = "1_overall-gender-composition-2010-2020"}
# Overall Gender Composition, 2010‑2020 only

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Step 1: Load the data first
nephro_data <- read_csv("/home/vandana/gender-bias/nephro_summary_with_distance.csv")

# Step 2: Process it
gender_totals <- nephro_data %>%
  filter(v_year >= 2010 & v_year <= 2020) %>%     # restrict to 2010‑2020
  summarise(
    female = sum(female, na.rm = TRUE),
    male   = sum(male,   na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(),
               names_to  = "Gender",
               values_to = "Count")

ggplot(gender_totals, aes(x = "", y = Count, fill = Gender)) +
  geom_col(width = 1) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  labs(title = "Overall Gender Composition (2010–2020) for Nephrology") +
  theme_void(base_size = 10) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("female" = "#E69F00", "male" = "#56B4E9")) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(Gender, ": ",
                               round(100 * Count / sum(Count), 1), "%")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            color = "white", size = 5)

```

```{r patient count, fig.cap = "2_total_patient_contribution_by_top_80-2010-2020"}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(ggsci)

# Step 1: Load data
nephro_data <- read_csv("/home/vandana/gender-bias/nephro_summary_with_distance.csv")

# Step 2: Filter for years and clean district names
nephro_data <- nephro_data %>%
  filter(v_year >= 2010 & v_year <= 2020) %>%
  mutate(final_district = str_to_title(str_trim(final_district)))

# Step 3: Calculate total patients
total_patients <- sum(nephro_data$total_male_female, na.rm = TRUE)

# Step 4: Calculate district contribution
district_contribution <- nephro_data %>%
  group_by(final_district) %>%
  summarise(patients = sum(total_male_female, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(patients)) %>%
  mutate(
    percent = round(100 * patients / total_patients, 2),
    cum_percent = cumsum(patients) / total_patients
  )

# Step 5: Get districts contributing up to 80%
top_80_districts <- district_contribution %>%
  filter(cum_percent <= 0.80)

# Step 6: Plot
ggplot(top_80_districts, aes(x = reorder(final_district, -percent), y = percent)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = pal_aaas()(1), width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(percent, "%")), vjust = -0.3, size = 2.8) +
  labs(
    title = "Districts Contributing to 80% of Patients (2010–2020) – Nephrology",
    x = "District (ordered by contribution)",
    y = "% of Total Patients (Male + Female)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```
```{r patient_count, fig.cap= "3_patient_count_without_lucknow"}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(ggsci)

# Step 1: Load data
nephro_data <- read_csv("/home/vandana/gender-bias/nephro_summary_with_distance.csv")

# Step 2: Filter for years and clean district names
nephro_data <- nephro_data %>%
  filter(v_year >= 2010 & v_year <= 2020) %>%
  mutate(final_district = str_to_title(str_trim(final_district)))

# Step 3: Calculate total patients
total_patients <- sum(nephro_data$total_male_female, na.rm = TRUE)

# Step 4: Calculate district contribution
district_contribution <- nephro_data %>%
  group_by(final_district) %>%
  summarise(
    patients = sum(total_male_female, na.rm = TRUE),
    Distance_km = mean(Distance_km, na.rm = TRUE),  # bring distance info in
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(patients)) %>%
  mutate(
    percent = round(100 * patients / total_patients, 2),
    cum_percent = cumsum(patients) / total_patients
  )

# Step 5: Save Lucknow data and remove from dataset
lucknow_count <- district_contribution %>%
  filter(final_district == "Lucknow") %>%
  pull(patients)

district_contribution <- district_contribution %>%
  filter(final_district != "Lucknow")

# Step 6: Get districts contributing up to 80%
top_80_districts <- district_contribution %>%
  filter(cum_percent <= 0.80)

# Step 7: Plot, ordered by distance
ggplot(top_80_districts, aes(x = reorder(final_district, Distance_km), y = percent)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = pal_aaas()(1), width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0("N=", patients)), vjust = -0.8, size = 2.7) +
  labs(
    title = "Districts Contributing to 80% of Patients (2010–2020) – Nephrology",
    x = "District (ordered by Distance from Lucknow)",
    y = "% of Total Patients (Male + Female)",
    caption = paste0("Lucknow (excluded) had N = ", format(lucknow_count, big.mark = ","))
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```

```{r nephro_female_dist, fig.cap= "4_districts-80-percent-2010-2020_nephrology_female"}


library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)

# Step 1: Load the data
district_data <- read_csv("/home/vandana/gender-bias/nephro_summary_with_distance.csv")

# Step 2: Filter to 2010–2020 window and clean district names
district_2010_20 <- district_data %>%
  filter(v_year >= 2010 & v_year <= 2020) %>%
  mutate(final_district = str_to_title(str_trim(final_district)))

# Step 3: Total patients (all genders)
total_patients_2010_20 <- sum(district_2010_20$total_male_female, na.rm = TRUE)

# Step 4: Identify top 80% districts by total patients
district_contribution <- district_2010_20 %>%
  group_by(final_district) %>%
  summarise(patients = sum(total_male_female, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(patients)) %>%
  mutate(
    cum_percent = cumsum(patients) / total_patients_2010_20
  )

top_80_districts <- district_contribution %>%
  filter(cum_percent <= 0.80)

# Step 5: Female contribution from top 80% districts
female_contribution <- district_2010_20 %>%
  filter(final_district %in% top_80_districts$final_district) %>%
  group_by(final_district) %>%
  summarise(female_patients = sum(female, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    percent = round(100 * female_patients / total_patients_2010_20, 2)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(percent))

# Step 6: Plot
ggplot(female_contribution,
       aes(x = reorder(final_district, -percent), y = percent)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "darkblue", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(percent, "%")), vjust = -0.2, size = 2.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Female Contribution from Top 80% Districts (2010–2020) – Nephrology",
    x     = "District (ordered by % contribution)",
    y     = "Female Patients as % of All 2010‑2020 Visits"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r stacked_graph_gender, fig.cap= "5_stacked_gender_plot"}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(ggsci)
library(tidyr)

district_data <- read.csv("/home/vandana/gender-bias/nephro_summary_with_distance.csv") %>%
  filter(v_year >= 2010 & v_year <= 2020) %>%
  mutate(final_district = str_to_title(str_trim(final_district)))

# STEP 2: Get total patients
total_patients <- sum(district_data$total_male_female, na.rm = TRUE)

# STEP 3: Calculate total patient contribution by district
district_contribution <- district_data %>%
  group_by(final_district) %>%
  summarise(patients = sum(total_male_female, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(patients)) %>%
  mutate(
    cum_percent = cumsum(patients) / total_patients
  )

# STEP 4: Select top 80% contributing districts
top_80_districts <- district_contribution %>%
  filter(cum_percent <= 0.80)

# STEP 5: Summarise male/female/total per district + min distance
district_visits <- district_data %>%
  filter(final_district %in% top_80_districts$final_district) %>%
  group_by(final_district) %>%
  summarise(
    female = sum(female, na.rm = TRUE),
    male = sum(male, na.rm = TRUE),
    total = sum(total_male_female, na.rm = TRUE),
    Distance_km = min(Distance_km, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(final_district != "Lucknow")  # Remove Lucknow


#creating labels

district_visits <- district_visits %>%
  mutate(
    female_percent = round(100 * female / total_patients, 2),
    male_percent   = round(100 * male / total_patients, 2),
    total_percent  = round(100 * total / total_patients, 2)
  )

district_long <- district_visits %>%
  select(final_district, Distance_km, female_percent, male_percent) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(female_percent, male_percent),
    names_to = "Gender",
    values_to = "Percent"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Gender = recode(Gender,
                         female_percent = "Female",
                         male_percent = "Male"))

# STEP 6: Calculate Lucknow's percentage
lucknow_contribution <- district_data %>%
  filter(final_district == "Lucknow") %>%
  summarise(total = sum(total_male_female, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(percent = round(100 * total / total_patients, 2)) %>%
  pull(percent)

# Plot
ggplot(district_long, aes(x = reorder(final_district, Distance_km), y = Percent, fill = Gender)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", width = 0.7) +

  # Female % inside blue bar
  geom_text(
    data = district_long %>% filter(Gender == "Female"),
    aes(label = paste0(Percent, "%")),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 2.6),
    size = 3,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  # Total % above each bar
  geom_text(
    data = district_visits,  # now has total_percent
    aes(x = reorder(final_district, Distance_km), y = total_percent, label = paste0(total_percent, "%")),
    vjust = -0.5,
    size = 3.2,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Patients (2010–2020) by Gender and District of Residence",
    subtitle = "Female % inside blue bar, Total % above bar — Ordered by distance from Lucknow",
    x = "District (by increasing distance from Lucknow)",
    y = "Percent of Total Patients",
    fill = "Gender",
    caption = paste0("Note: Lucknow's contribution to total patients = ", lucknow_contribution, "%")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Female" = "steelblue", "Male" = "#E69F00")) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```

```{r nephro_visit_type, fig.cap= "6_nephrology_visit_type"}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(ggsci)

# Step 1: Load data
nephro_data <- read_csv("/home/vandana/gender-bias/nephro_summary_with_distance.csv")

# Step 2: Filter for years and clean district names
nephro_data <- nephro_data %>%
  filter(v_year >= 2010 & v_year <= 2020) %>%
  mutate(final_district = str_to_title(str_trim(final_district)))

# Step 3: Save Lucknow patient counts for caption
lucknow_counts <- nephro_data %>%
  filter(final_district == "Lucknow") %>%
  group_by(v_type) %>%
  summarise(count = sum(male + female, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ip_lucknow <- lucknow_counts$count[lucknow_counts$v_type == "IP"]
op_lucknow <- lucknow_counts$count[lucknow_counts$v_type == "OP"]

# Step 4: Exclude Lucknow
nephro_data <- nephro_data %>%
  filter(final_district != "Lucknow")

# Step 5: Group by year and visit type
plot_data <- nephro_data %>%
  group_by(v_year, v_type) %>%
  summarise(Total = sum(male + female, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Step 6: Calculate total patients across all years (for percentage)
total_all_years <- sum(plot_data$Total)

# Step 7: Add percentage column
plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(Percentage = (Total / total_all_years) * 100)

# Step 8: Plot
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = factor(v_year), y = Percentage, fill = v_type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = Total),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 3.5,
    color = "white"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1)) +
  scale_fill_aaas() +
  labs(
    title = "Nephrology Visits by Year (2010–2020)",
    subtitle = "Visit types: IP/OP (Lucknow excluded)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Percentage of Total Patients (2010–2020)",
    fill = "Visit Type",
    caption = paste0(
      "Note: Lucknow excluded. IP_Lucknow = ", format(ip_lucknow, big.mark = ","), 
      ", OP_Lucknow = ", format(op_lucknow, big.mark = ",")
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

```


```{r nephro_visit_gender, fig.cap= "7_nephro_visit_gender"}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(ggsci)

# Step 1: Load data
nephro_data <- read_csv("/home/vandana/gender-bias/nephro_summary_with_distance.csv")

# Step 2: Filter for years and clean district names
nephro_data <- nephro_data %>%
  filter(v_year >= 2010 & v_year <= 2020) %>%
  mutate(final_district = str_to_title(str_trim(final_district)))

# Step 3: Reshape to long format by gender
plot_data <- nephro_data %>%
  select(v_year, male, female) %>%
  group_by(v_year) %>%
  summarise(
    male = sum(male, na.rm = TRUE),
    female = sum(female, na.rm = TRUE),

    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 3.5,
    color = "white"

  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1)) +
  scale_fill_aaas() +
  labs(
    title = "Nephrology Visits by Gender and Year (2010–2020)",
    subtitle = "Includes all districts including Lucknow",
    x = "Year",

    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

```{r female_v_type, fig.cap= "8_Prevalence for Female Patients for v_type(2010–2020) Nephrology" }

# Load required libraries
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggsci)
library(stringr)

# Read the input summary data
nephro_summary_with_distance <- read.csv("/home/vandana/gender-bias/nephro_summary_with_distance.csv")

# 1. Overall Prevalence Bar Chart (2010–2020)
overall_data <- nephro_summary_with_distance %>%
  filter(v_year >= 2010 & v_year <= 2020) %>%
  group_by(v_type) %>%
  summarise(
    total_female = sum(female, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_visits = sum(total_male_female, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#  NEW: denominator = all visits (male + female) in IP + OP together
grand_total_visits <- sum(overall_data$total_visits)

overall_data <- overall_data %>%
  mutate(
    percent_female = round(100 * total_female / grand_total_visits, 1),
    label = paste0(percent_female, "%\nN=", total_visits)
  )

# Add Total row (same denominator)
total_row <- overall_data %>%
  summarise(
    v_type         = "Total",
    total_female   = sum(total_female),
    total_visits   = grand_total_visits,
    percent_female = round(100 * total_female / grand_total_visits, 1)
  ) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(percent_female, "%\nN=", total_visits))

overall_plot_data <- bind_rows(overall_data, total_row)

ggplot(overall_plot_data, aes(x = v_type, y = percent_female, fill = v_type)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), vjust = -0.5, size = 3.2) +
  scale_fill_aaas() +
  labs(
    title = "Proportion of Female Patients (2010–2020) by Visit Type",
    x = "Visit Type",
    y = "% of Female Patients"
  ) +
  ylim(0, 100) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```

```{r visit_type_total_patient, fig.cap= "9_visit_type_total_patient"}
## Load required libraries
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggsci)
library(stringr)

# Read the input summary data
nephro_summary_with_distance <- read.csv("/home/vandana/gender-bias/nephro_summary_with_distance.csv")

# Filter and summarize data (2010–2020)
visit_data <- nephro_summary_with_distance %>%
  filter(v_year >= 2010 & v_year <= 2020) %>%
  group_by(v_type) %>%
  summarise(
    total_visits = sum(total_male_female, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Calculate total and percent, and create combined label
grand_total_visits <- sum(visit_data$total_visits)

visit_data <- visit_data %>%
  mutate(
    percent_visits = round(100 * total_visits / grand_total_visits, 1),
    label = paste0(percent_visits, "%\nN=", total_visits)
  )

# Plot: % of Total Visits with N label
ggplot(visit_data, aes(x = v_type, y = percent_visits, fill = v_type)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), vjust = -0.2, size = 3.2) +
  scale_fill_aaas() +
  labs(
    title = "Proportion of Total Visits (2010–2020) by Visit Type",
    x = "Visit Type",
    y = "% of Total Visits"
  ) +
  ylim(0, 100) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```

```{r v_type_gender_per_year, fig.cap= "10_v_type_gender_per_year"}

#9_Percentage of Patient Visits by Gender and Visit Type Over Years
# Load libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggsci)

# Load data
nephro_summary_with_distance <- read.csv("/home/vandana/gender-bias/nephro_summary_with_distance.csv")

# Reshape and prepare data
plot_data <- nephro_summary_with_distance %>%
  filter(v_year >= 2010 & v_year <= 2020) %>%
  filter(v_type %in% c("IP", "OP"), !is.na(v_year)) %>%
  select(v_year, v_type, male, female) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(male, female), names_to = "Gender", values_to = "Count") %>%
  mutate(
    Gender = ifelse(Gender == "male", "Male", "Female"),
    Group = paste(Gender, v_type, sep = "_")
  )

# Calculate raw counts and group by year and group
summary_data <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(v_year, Group) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(Count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Calculate total across all years
total_all_years <- sum(summary_data$n)

# Calculate overall % contribution across all years
summary_data <- summary_data %>%
  mutate(perc = round((n / total_all_years) * 100, 2))

# Total patients per year
total_by_year <- summary_data %>%
  group_by(v_year) %>%
  summarise(Total = sum(n), .groups = "drop")

# Find the top of the stacked bar (max y per year)
bar_top_by_year <- summary_data %>%
  group_by(v_year) %>%
  summarise(y_position = sum(perc), .groups = "drop")

# Join the total count label with y_position info
total_by_year_label <- left_join(total_by_year, bar_top_by_year, by = "v_year") %>%
  mutate(y_position = y_position + 0.5)  # offset above bar

# Final plot
ggplot(summary_data, aes(x = factor(v_year), y = perc, fill = Group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 2.5, color = "black") +
  geom_text(data = total_by_year_label,
            aes(x = factor(v_year), y = y_position, label = paste0("N=", Total)),
            size = 3.2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Female_IP" = "#4E79A7",
      "Male_IP" = "orange",
      "Female_OP" = "darkgreen",
      "Male_OP" = "red"
    ),
    name = "Group"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Proportion of Patients by Year (2010-2020) and by Visit Type",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Percentage of Patients (Relative to Total 2010–2020)"
  ) +
  ylim(0, 17) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

```

```{r  v_type_gender_per_dist, fig.cap= "11_v_type_gender_per_dist"}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(ggsci)
library(tidyr)

# Load and clean data
district_data <- read.csv("/home/vandana/gender-bias/nephro_summary_with_distance.csv") %>%
  filter(v_year >= 2010 & v_year <= 2020, v_type %in% c("IP", "OP")) %>%
  mutate(final_district = str_to_title(str_trim(final_district)))

# Total patient count
total_patients <- sum(district_data$total_male_female, na.rm = TRUE)

# Get top 80% districts
district_contribution <- district_data %>%
  group_by(final_district) %>%
  summarise(patients = sum(total_male_female, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(patients)) %>%
  mutate(cum_percent = cumsum(patients) / total_patients)

top_80_districts <- district_contribution %>%
  filter(cum_percent <= 0.80)

# Summarise gender-wise + IP/OP per district
district_visits <- district_data %>%
  filter(final_district %in% top_80_districts$final_district, final_district != "Lucknow") %>%
  group_by(final_district, v_type) %>%
  summarise(
    female = sum(female, na.rm = TRUE),
    male = sum(male, na.rm = TRUE),
    total = sum(total_male_female, na.rm = TRUE),
    Distance_km = min(Distance_km, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    female_percent = round(100 * female / total_patients, 2),
    male_percent = round(100 * male / total_patients, 2),
    total_percent = round(100 * total / total_patients, 2)
  )

# Reshape for plotting
district_long <- district_visits %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(female_percent, male_percent),
               names_to = "Gender", values_to = "Percent") %>%
  mutate(
    Gender = recode(Gender, female_percent = "Female", male_percent = "Male"),
    Group = paste(Gender, v_type, sep = "_")
  )

# Lucknow's contribution
lucknow_contribution <- district_data %>%
  filter(final_district == "Lucknow") %>%
  summarise(total = sum(total_male_female, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(percent = round(100 * total / total_patients, 2)) %>%
  pull(percent)

# Compute total percent per district (for positioning label)
total_bar_heights <- district_long %>%
  group_by(final_district) %>%
  summarise(total_perc = sum(Percent), .groups = "drop")

# Merge with Female_IP summary
summary_data <- district_long %>%
  filter(Group == "Female_IP") %>%
  group_by(final_district, v_type, Group) %>%
  summarise(perc = sum(Percent), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(total_bar_heights, by = "final_district")

# Plot
ggplot(district_long, aes(x = reorder(final_district, Distance_km), y = Percent, fill = Group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", width = 0.7) +

  # Add Female_IP % at top of bar
  geom_text(data = summary_data,
            aes(x = final_district, y = total_perc + 1, label = paste0(perc, "%")),
            color = "black", size = 2.8, fontface = "bold", vjust = 4, inherit.aes = FALSE) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Female_IP" = "#4E79A7",
      "Male_IP" = "orange",
      "Female_OP" = "darkgreen",
      "Male_OP" = "red"
    ),
    name = "Group"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Patients (2010–2020) by Gender and Visit Type across Districts",
    subtitle = "Female % on top of bar, Lucknow hidden in the plot",
    x = "District (ordered by distance from Lucknow)",
    y = "Percent of Total Patients (2010–2020)",
    caption = paste0("Note: Lucknow's contribution to total patients = ", lucknow_contribution, "%")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```

```{r normalized_plot, fig.cap= "13_normalized_nephrology_p_visits_for_2011_District_Population"}

# ── Libraries ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)

# ── 1. Load data ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
census_2011 <- read_csv("/home/vandana/gender-bias/india-districts-census-2011.csv")
nephro_raw  <- read.csv ("/home/vandana/gender-bias/nephro_summary_with_distance.csv")   # your pre‑prepared summary

# ── 2. Clean & filter nephrology records (2010‑2020) ─────────────────────────
nephro_clean <- nephro_raw %>%
  filter(dplyr::between(v_year, 2010, 2020)) %>%
  mutate(
    final_district = str_to_lower(str_trim(final_district)),
    final_state    = str_to_lower(str_trim(final_state)),
    
    # Fix name mismatch for proper join with census
    final_district = if_else(final_district == "kanpur", "kanpur nagar", final_district)
  ) %>%
  filter(!(final_district == "pratapgarh" & final_state != "uttar pradesh"))


# ── 3. Summarise visits per district ─────────────────────────────────────────
district_visits <- nephro_clean %>%
  group_by(final_district) %>%
  summarise(
    Distance_km  = min(Distance_km, na.rm = TRUE),          # one distance / district
    total_visits = sum(total_male_female, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups      = "drop"
  )

# ── 4. Keep districts accounting for the first 80 % of visits ────────────────
top_districts <- district_visits %>%
  arrange(desc(total_visits)) %>%
  mutate(cum_pct = cumsum(total_visits) / sum(total_visits)) %>%
  filter(cum_pct <= 0.8)

# ── 5. Prepare 2011 census population data ───────────────────────────────────
census_clean <- census_2011 %>%
  mutate(`District name` = str_to_lower(str_trim(`District name`))) %>%
  select(final_district = `District name`, Population)

# ── 6. Join visits with population ───────────────────────────────────────────
top_with_pop <- top_districts %>%
  left_join(census_clean, by = "final_district") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Population))         # drop districts missing pop data if any

# (optional alias, if you still want the old name)
# top_90_with_pop <- top_with_pop

# ── 7. Compute % of population and plot ──────────────────────────────────────
df_norm <- top_with_pop %>%
  mutate(patient_percent = 100 * total_visits / Population) %>%
  arrange(Distance_km) %>%
  distinct(final_district, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%            # ensure no dups
  mutate(final_district = factor(final_district,
                                 levels = unique(final_district)))

ggplot(df_norm,
       aes(x = final_district, y = patient_percent)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2E6F40") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", patient_percent)),
            vjust = -0.3, size = 2.5) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = str_to_title) +
  labs(
    title    = "Patient Visit-District Population Normalized Graph",
    x        = "District (ordered by distance from Lucknow)",
    y        = "Patients (2010-20) / Population(2011 census) (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```

```{r lineplot_patient_dist, fig.cap= "15_lineplot_patient_dist"}

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggsci)

# 1 Summarize data
district_year_data <- read.csv("/home/vandana/gender-bias/nephro_summary_with_distance.csv") %>%
  filter(v_year >= 2010 & v_year <= 2020) %>%
  mutate(final_district = str_to_title(str_trim(final_district))) %>%
  group_by(v_year, final_district) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(total_male_female, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 2 Total N (2010-2020)
N_total <- sum(district_year_data$n, na.rm = TRUE)

# 3 Add percent
district_year_data <- district_year_data %>%
  mutate(percent = round(100 * n / N_total, 2))

# 4 Identify top districts by cumulative contribution (include Lucknow)
district_total <- district_year_data %>%
  group_by(final_district) %>%
  summarise(total_patients = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(total_patients)) %>%
  mutate(
    cum_percent = cumsum(total_patients) / N_total,
    rank = row_number()
  )

# Force include Lucknow
top_districts <- district_total %>%
  filter(cum_percent <= 0.8 | final_district == "Lucknow") %>%
  pull(final_district)

# 5 Label non-top districts as "Other"
district_year_data <- district_year_data %>%
  mutate(final_district = ifelse(final_district %in% top_districts, final_district, "Other"))

# 6 Merge rank for coloring
district_year_data <- district_year_data %>%
  left_join(district_total[, c("final_district", "rank")], by = "final_district") %>%
  mutate(rank = ifelse(final_district == "Other", NA, rank))

# 7 Create color palette based on rank
palette <- scales::viridis_pal(option = "D")(length(unique(na.omit(district_year_data$rank))))
names(palette) <- district_total %>%
  filter(final_district %in% top_districts) %>%
  arrange(rank) %>%
  pull(final_district)

# Add grey for "Other"
palette["Other"] <- "grey80"

# 8 Plot
ggplot(district_year_data, aes(x = v_year, y = percent, color = final_district)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -0.7, size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = palette) +
  labs(
    title = "% of Patients by District and Year (2010–2020)",
    subtitle = paste("N =", N_total),
    x = "Year",
    y = "% of Total Patients per district",
    color = "District"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2010, 2020, 1)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

```{r lineplot_dist_year_female, fig.cap= "17_lineplot_dist_year_female"}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggsci)

# ── STEP 1: Summarize female patient data by year and district ────────────────────────
district_year_data <- nephro_summary_with_distance %>%
  filter(v_year >= 2010 & v_year <= 2020) %>%
  mutate(final_district = str_to_title(str_trim(final_district))) %>%
  group_by(v_year, final_district) %>%
  summarise(
    female_patients = sum(female, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ── STEP 2: Total patients 2010–2020 ────────────────────────
total_patients <- nephro_summary_with_distance %>%
  filter(v_year >= 2010 & v_year <= 2020) %>%
  summarise(total_patients = sum(total_male_female, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(total_patients)

# ── STEP 3: Compute % contribution ────────────────────────
district_year_data <- district_year_data %>%
  mutate(percent = round(100 * female_patients / total_patients, 2))

# ── STEP 4: Rank districts based on total contribution ────────────────────────
district_total <- nephro_summary_with_distance %>%
  filter(v_year >= 2010 & v_year <= 2020) %>%
  mutate(final_district = str_to_title(str_trim(final_district))) %>%
  group_by(final_district) %>%
  summarise(total_patients_district = sum(total_male_female, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(total_patients_district)) %>%
  mutate(cum_percent = cumsum(total_patients_district) / sum(total_patients_district))

# Identify top contributors up to 80% cumulatively
top_districts <- district_total %>%
  filter(cum_percent <= 0.8) %>%
  pull(final_district)

# Assign ranks
district_total <- district_total %>%
  mutate(rank = rank(-total_patients_district, ties.method = "first"))

# Keep only top districts and assign factor levels based on rank
district_year_data <- district_year_data %>%
  mutate(final_district = ifelse(final_district %in% top_districts, final_district, "Other")) %>%
  left_join(district_total %>% select(final_district, rank), by = "final_district") %>%
  mutate(rank = ifelse(is.na(rank), max(district_total$rank) + 1, rank)) %>%
  mutate(final_district = reorder(final_district, rank))

# ── STEP 5: Plot ────────────────────────
ggplot(district_year_data, aes(x = v_year, y = percent, color = final_district, group = final_district)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = female_patients), vjust = -0.7, size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = ggsci::pal_lancet()(length(unique(district_year_data$final_district)))) +
  labs(
    title = "Female % of Total Patients by District and Year (2010–2020) Nephrology",
    subtitle = paste("Total N =", total_patients),
    x = "Year",
    y = "Female % of Total Patients (2010–2020)",
    color = "District"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2010, 2020, 1)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

```{r lineplot_dist_year_female_lucknow_hidden, fig.cap= "18_lineplot_dist_year_female_Lucknow_hidden"}
plot_data <- district_year_data %>%
  filter(final_district != "Lucknow")

# 6 Plot
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = v_year, y = percent, color = final_district)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -0.7, size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_lancet() +
  labs(
    title = "Female % by District and Year (2010–2020, Lucknow Hidden in Plot) Nephrology",
    subtitle = paste("N =", N_total),
    x = "Year",
    y = "female % of Total Patients (2010–2020)",
    color = "District"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2010, 2020, 1)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

```{r}
# 15_Patient_Distance_from_Lucknow_Nephroloyg_Pearson_coor

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(geosphere)  # optional, if you want to recompute distance

# Load data
nephro_data <- read_csv("/home/vandana/gender-bias/nephro_summary_with_distance.csv")


# Step 1: Filter and sort for top 90% contributing districts
top_90_data <- nephro_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Distance_km)) %>%
  group_by(final_district) %>%
  summarise(
    total = sum(total_male_female, na.rm = TRUE),
    Distance_km = mean(Distance_km, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total)) %>%
  mutate(
    cum_sum = cumsum(total),
    total_all = sum(total),
    cum_percent = cum_sum / total_all
  ) %>%
  filter(cum_percent <= 0.90)

# -----------------------------
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# ----------- Plot 1: Including Lucknow -----------

plot_data_inc <- top_90_data
N_inc <- sum(plot_data_inc$total, na.rm = TRUE)

plot_data_inc <- plot_data_inc %>%
  mutate(
    percent = round(100 * total / N_inc, 2),
    abbr = tolower(str_sub(final_district, 1, 3))
  )

# Compute Pearson correlation (including Lucknow)
cor_val_inc <- cor(plot_data_inc$Distance_km, plot_data_inc$percent, use = "complete.obs")
cor_label_inc <- paste0("Pearson r = ", round(cor_val_inc, 2))

ggplot(plot_data_inc, aes(x = Distance_km, y = percent)) +
  geom_point(color = "#004D4D", size = 1.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "#9AD8D8", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.5) +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = cor_label_inc, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 2, size = 4) +
  labs(
    title = "Patient % vs Distance from Lucknow (Top 90% Districts, Including Lucknow)",
    x = "Distance from Lucknow (km)",
    y = "Patient %"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10)

# ----------- Plot 2: Excluding Lucknow -----------
# Remove Lucknow from plot ONLY (do not recalculate %)
plot_data_exc <- plot_data_inc %>% 
  filter(final_district != "Lucknow")  # keep original percent values

# Pearson correlation on original % (excluding Lucknow)
cor_val_exc <- cor(plot_data_exc$Distance_km, plot_data_exc$percent, use = "complete.obs")
cor_label_exc <- paste0("Pearson r = ", round(cor_val_exc, 2))

# Plot (without Lucknow, but using original percent)
ggplot(plot_data_exc, aes(x = Distance_km, y = percent)) +
  geom_point(color = "#004D4D", size = 1.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = abbr), vjust = -0.7, size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "#9AD8D8", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.5) +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = cor_label_exc, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 2, size = 4) +
  labs(
    title = "Patient % vs Distance from Lucknow (Top 90% Districts, Excluding Lucknow)",
    x = "Distance from Lucknow (km)",
    y = "Patient %"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
```

```{r Nephrology Patient Share by District (2010–2020) India Map, fig.cap= "heatmap India for patient visit"}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)

# 1️ Read shapefile
india_districts <- st_read("/home/vandana/gender-bias/IND_adm2.shp")

# 2️ Clean district names
india_districts <- india_districts %>%
  mutate(NAME_2 = str_to_title(str_trim(NAME_2)))

# 3️ Summarize Nephrology data
nephro_by_district <- nephro_summary_with_distance %>%
  filter(v_year >= 2010 & v_year <= 2020) %>%
  mutate(final_district = str_to_title(str_trim(final_district)),
         final_district = ifelse(final_district == "Kanpur Nagar", "Kanpur", final_district)) %>%
  group_by(final_district) %>%
  summarise(patient_count = sum(total_male_female, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# 4️ Compute % contribution
total_patients <- sum(nephro_by_district$patient_count, na.rm = TRUE)
nephro_by_district <- nephro_by_district %>%
  mutate(
    pct = patient_count / total_patients * 100,
    contrib_bin = case_when(
      pct > 50                 ~ ">50%",
      pct > 4  & pct <= 50     ~ "4–50%",
      pct > 2  & pct <= 4      ~ "2–4%",
      pct > 1  & pct <= 2      ~ "1–2%",
      pct >= 0.1 & pct <= 1    ~ "0.1–1%",
      TRUE                     ~ "<0.1%"
    )
  )

# 5️ Join with map
map_data <- india_districts %>%
  left_join(nephro_by_district, by = c("NAME_2" = "final_district"))

# 6️ Plot
ggplot(map_data) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = contrib_bin), color = "grey80", size = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(">50%" = "yellow", "4–50%" = "orange", "2–4%" = "blue", 
               "1–2%" = "green", "0.1–1%" = "black", "<0.1%" = "grey90"),
    na.value = "white",
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Nephrology Patient Share by District (2010–2020)",
    subtitle = paste("Total patients =", total_patients),
    fill = "District share"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())

```

```{r heatmap UP and Bihar, fig.cap= "UP_Bihar_gender_heatmap"}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)

# 1️⃣ Load shapefile
india_districts <- st_read("/home/vandana/gender-bias/IND_adm2.shp")

# 2️⃣ Filter map for Uttar Pradesh and Bihar
india_districts <- india_districts %>%
  mutate(
    NAME_1 = str_to_title(str_trim(NAME_1)),
    NAME_2 = str_to_title(str_trim(NAME_2))
  ) %>%
  filter(NAME_1 %in% c("Uttar Pradesh", "Bihar"))

# 3️⃣ Load and summarize nephrology data
summary_gender <- read.csv("/home/vandana/gender-bias/nephro_summary_with_distance.csv") %>%
  filter(v_year >= 2010 & v_year <= 2020) %>%
  mutate(
    final_state = str_to_title(str_trim(final_state)),
    final_district = str_to_title(str_trim(final_district)),
    final_district = ifelse(final_district == "Kanpur Nagar", "Kanpur", final_district)
  ) %>%
  group_by(final_state, final_district) %>%
  summarise(
    total_male = sum(male, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_female = sum(female, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_patients = sum(total_male_female, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 4️⃣ National total
total_all <- sum(summary_gender$total_patients, na.rm = TRUE)

# 5️⃣ Compute male and female % relative to national total
summary_gender <- summary_gender %>%
  mutate(
    male_pct = round((total_male / total_all) * 100, 3),
    female_pct = round((total_female / total_all) * 100, 3)
  )

# 6️⃣ Reshape data to long format for gender
long_summary <- summary_gender %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(male_pct, female_pct),
    names_to = "Gender",
    values_to = "Percentage"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Gender = ifelse(Gender == "male_pct", "Male", "Female"),
    contrib_bin = case_when(
      Percentage > 5                        ~ ">5%",
      Percentage > 3 & Percentage <= 5      ~ "3–5%",
      Percentage > 2 & Percentage <= 3      ~ "2–3%",
      Percentage > 1 & Percentage <= 2      ~ "1–2%",
      Percentage >= 0.1 & Percentage <= 1   ~ "0.1–1%",
      TRUE                                  ~ "<0.1%"
    )
  )

# 7️⃣ Define color palette
bin_colors <- c(
  ">5%" = "darkred",
  "3–5%" = "black",
  "2–3%" = "orange",
  "1–2%" = "yellow",
  "0.1–1%" = "red",
  "<0.1%" = "lightblue"
)

# 8️⃣ Merge map with gender summary
merged_map <- india_districts %>%
  left_join(long_summary, by = c("NAME_1" = "final_state", "NAME_2" = "final_district"))

# 9️⃣ Filter out districts with missing data
merged_map_clean <- merged_map %>%
  filter(!is.na(contrib_bin), Gender %in% c("Male", "Female"))

# 🔟 Plot faceted map
ggplot(merged_map_clean) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = contrib_bin), color = "white", size = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = bin_colors,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "District-wise Percentage Contribution of Male and Female Nephrology Patients (2010–2020)",
    subtitle = "Uttar Pradesh and Bihar | Percentage of National Total",
    fill = "Contribution"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~Gender) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

```



```{r heatmap_per_year, fig.cap= "heatmap Year Wise for India"}


library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)

# 1 Read shapefile
india_districts <- st_read("/home/vandana/gender-bias/IND_adm2.shp")

india_districts <- india_districts %>%
  mutate(NAME_2 = str_to_title(str_trim(NAME_2)))

# 2 Summarize nephrology data by district and year
nephro_by_district_year <- nephro_summary_with_distance %>%
  filter(v_year >= 2010 & v_year <= 2020) %>%
  mutate(
    final_district = str_to_title(str_trim(final_district)),
    final_district = ifelse(final_district == "Kanpur Nagar", "Kanpur", final_district)
  ) %>%
  group_by(v_year, final_district) %>%
  summarise(
    patient_count = sum(total_male_female, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 3️ Total patients per year
yearly_totals <- nephro_by_district_year %>%
  group_by(v_year) %>%
  summarise(total_patients = sum(patient_count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# 4️ Calculate % contribution per district per year
nephro_by_district_year <- nephro_by_district_year %>%
  left_join(yearly_totals, by = "v_year") %>%
  mutate(pct = patient_count / total_patients * 100)

# 5️ Bin categories
nephro_by_district_year <- nephro_by_district_year %>%
  mutate(
    contrib_bin = case_when(
      pct > 50                    ~ ">50%",
      pct > 4 & pct <= 50         ~ "4–50%",
      pct > 2 & pct <= 4          ~ "2–4%",
      pct > 1 & pct <= 2          ~ "1–2%",
      pct >= 0.1 & pct <= 1       ~ "0.1–1%",
      TRUE                        ~ "<0.1%"
    )
  )

# 6️ Define colors
bin_colors <- c(
  ">50%" = "yellow",
  "4–50%" = "orange",
  "2–4%" = "blue",
  "1–2%" = "green",
  "0.1–1%" = "black",
  "<0.1%" = "pink"
)

# 7️ Pair years for plotting
year_pairs <- split(2010:2020, ceiling(seq_along(2010:2020) / 2))

for (pair in year_pairs) {
  ndy_pair <- nephro_by_district_year %>%
    filter(v_year %in% pair)
  
  map_data_pair <- india_districts %>%
    right_join(ndy_pair, by = c("NAME_2" = "final_district"))
  
  # Plot
  print(
    ggplot(map_data_pair) +
      geom_sf(aes(fill = contrib_bin), color = "grey80", size = 0.1) +
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = bin_colors,
        na.value = "grey90",
        drop = FALSE
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "Nephrology Patient Share by District",
        subtitle = paste0("Years: ", paste(pair, collapse = " & "), 
                          " | Each district’s % of national patient total"),
        fill = "District share"
      ) +
      facet_wrap(~v_year, ncol = 1, nrow = 2, labeller = label_both) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
      theme(
        axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9)
      )
  )
}
```

```{r combined heatmap, fig.cap= "combined_heatmap_year_wise"}
bin_colors <- c(
  ">50%"   = "yellow",
  "4-50%"  = "orange",
  "2-4%"   = "blue",
  "1-2%"   = "green",
  "0.1-1%" = "black",
  "<0.1%"  = "pink"
)

# 7️ Create list of cleaned-up maps
plot_list <- list()
for (yr in 2010:2020) {
  ndy_year <- nephro_by_district_year %>% filter(v_year == yr)
  map_data_year <- india_districts %>%
    right_join(ndy_year, by = c("NAME_2" = "final_district"))
  
  p <- ggplot(map_data_year %>% filter(!is.na(contrib_bin))) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = contrib_bin), color = "grey80", size = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = bin_colors,
      na.value = "grey90",
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Year:", yr),
      subtitle = paste("Total patients:", unique(ndy_year$total_patients))
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8)
    )
  
  plot_list[[as.character(yr)]] <- p
}

# 8️ Combine plots: 4 per row
combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 4) &
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# 9️ Display the combined plot
print(combined_plot)


```

```{r patient_service_file}
# ── Libraries ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)

# ── 1. Load the master file ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
data_path <- "/home/vandana/gender-bias/Treatment_files/p_id_services_with_location_dates.csv"

# ── 2. Explode the comma‑separated `services` column 
service_long <- df %>%
  select(patient_id, p_gender, final_district, final_state, services) %>%
  mutate(services = str_split(services, ",")) %>%   # list column
  unnest(services) %>%                              # → one row per service
  mutate(services = str_trim(services))             # trim spaces

# ── 3. Count how many times each patient used each service ───────────────────
service_count <- service_long %>%
  group_by(patient_id, p_gender, final_district, final_state, services) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")

# ── 4. Pivot wider (one column per service) ──────────────────────────────────
patient_service_table <- service_count %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = services,
    values_from = count,
    values_fill = 0
  )

# ── 5. Write to CSV ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
write_csv(
  patient_service_table,
  "/home/vandana/gender-bias/Treatment_files/patient_service_table.csv"
)
```

```{r Treatment by gender, fig.cap= "treatment_by_gender"}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# ── STEP 1: Load data ───────────────────────────────
patient_service_table <- read_csv("/home/vandana/gender-bias/Treatment_files/patient_service_table.csv")

# ── STEP 2: Select the 12 services ──────────────────
selected_services <- c(
  "Haemodialysis reprocessing unit",
  "Haemodialysis Maintenence",
  "Reuse Haemodialysis",
  "Tunneled cuffed dialysis catheter(Permacath) insertion",
  "RENAL TRANSPLANTATION (RECEPIENT)",
  "Plasmapheresis+Hemodialysis(1st Session)",
  "Plasmapheresis(Reuse)+Hemodialysis(reuse)",
  "Peritoneal Dialysis Manual",
  "Peritoneal Dialysis Cycler",
  "USG guided internal Jugular Dialysis catheter insertion",
  "TOTAL PARATHYROIDECTOMY WITHOUT TRANSPLANTATION",
  "Haemodialysis (Initial)"
)

# ── STEP 3 (revised) : counts + overall‑percent ──────────────────────────────
service_patient_percent_gender <- patient_service_table %>%
  filter(tolower(p_gender) %in% c("male", "female")) %>%
  mutate(p_gender = tolower(p_gender)) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(selected_services), list(
    male   = ~ sum(. > 0 & p_gender == "male",   na.rm = TRUE),
    female = ~ sum(. > 0 & p_gender == "female", na.rm = TRUE)
  ))) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols        = everything(),
    names_to    = c("Service", "p_gender"),
    names_sep   = "_",
    values_to   = "Count"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Percent = round(100 * Count / sum(Count), 2))   # <-- one global sum

# ── PLOT 1 : % of patients using each service by gender (global denominator) ─
ggplot(service_patient_percent_gender,
       aes(x = reorder(Service, Percent), y = Percent, fill = p_gender)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.5, position = "dodge") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("female" = "#E69F00", "male" = "#56B4E9"),
                    labels = c("female" = "Female", "male" = "Male")) +
  labs(
    title = "% of Patients Using Each Service by Gender (≥1 time)",
    x = "Service",
    y = "Percentage of All Service Uses (Male + Female)",
    fill = "Gender"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
```

```{r service_utilization_by_district, fig.cap= "service_utilization_by_district"}

# 25_stacked plot for services

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# ── Step 1: Load the dataset ─────────────────────────────
patient_service_table <- read_csv("/home/vandana/gender-bias/Treatment_files/patient_service_table.csv")

# ── Step 2: Count patients per district and compute cumulative percentage ───
district_patient_counts <- patient_service_table %>%
  group_by(final_district) %>%
  summarise(patient_count = n_distinct(patient_id), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(patient_count)) %>%
  mutate(cumulative_percent = cumsum(patient_count) / sum(patient_count) * 100)

# ── Step 3: Select districts that contribute to 80% of patients ─────────────
districts_80 <- district_patient_counts %>%
  filter(cumulative_percent <= 80) %>%
  pull(final_district)

# ── Step 4: Define service columns ──────────────────────────────────────────
service_columns <- colnames(patient_service_table)[5:16]

# ── Step 5: Pivot the full dataset to long format to get total service counts ─
all_services_long <- patient_service_table %>%
  select(final_district, all_of(service_columns)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(service_columns),
    names_to = "service",
    values_to = "used"
  ) %>%
  filter(used > 0)

# Total number of services used across ALL districts
total_service_usage_all_districts <- nrow(all_services_long)

# ── Step 6: Filter data for top 80% districts only ───────────────────────────
filtered_data <- patient_service_table %>%
  filter(final_district %in% districts_80)

# ── Step 7: Pivot filtered data to long format ──────────────────────────────
service_long_80 <- filtered_data %>%
  select(final_district, all_of(service_columns)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(service_columns),
    names_to = "service",
    values_to = "used"
  ) %>%
  filter(used > 0)

# ── Step 8: Calculate service percentage per district (with global denominator) ─
service_percent <- service_long_80 %>%
  group_by(final_district, service) %>%
  summarise(service_count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(percent = service_count / total_service_usage_all_districts * 100)

#abbrevation # Create a named vector for abbreviation mapping
service_abbrev <- c(
  "Haemodialysis reprocessing unit" = "HD Reproc",
  "Haemodialysis Maintenence" = "HD Maint",
  "Reuse Haemodialysis" = "HD Reuse",
  "Tunneled cuffed dialysis catheter(Permacath) insertion" = "Permacath Ins",
  "RENAL TRANSPLANTATION (RECEPIENT)" = "Renal Tx",
  "Plasmapheresis+Hemodialysis(1st Session)" = "PP+HD (1st)",
  "Plasmapheresis(Reuse)+Hemodialysis(reuse)" = "PP+HD (Reuse)",
  "Peritoneal Dialysis Manual" = "PD Manual",
  "Peritoneal Dialysis Cycler" = "PD Cycler",
  "USG guided internal Jugular Dialysis catheter insertion" = "USG IJC Ins",
  "TOTAL PARATHYROIDECTOMY WITHOUT TRANSPLANTATION" = "TPTX",
  "Haemodialysis (Initial)" = "HD Init"
)

# Replace service names with abbreviations
service_percent$service <- recode(service_percent$service, !!!service_abbrev)

# ── Step 9: Plot stacked bar chart ───────────────────────────────────────────
ggplot(service_percent, aes(x = reorder(final_district, -percent), y = percent, fill = service)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  labs(
    title = "Service Utilization in Top 80% Districts (as % of All Services)",
    x = "District",
    y = "Percentage of Total Services"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "Service (Abbrev)"))


#without lucknow
service_percent_no_lucknow <- service_percent %>%
  filter(final_district != "lucknow")

ggplot(service_percent_no_lucknow, aes(x = reorder(final_district, -percent), y = percent, fill = service)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  labs(
    title = "Service Utilization (Excluding Lucknow)",
    x = "District",
    y = "Percentage of Patient Visit for Services"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "Service (Abbrev)"))
```

```{r kaplan Meier Survival plot, fig.cap= "Kaplan_Meier_for_Transplant"}


library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(lubridate)

# ── 1. Load pre-filtered transplant patient data ─────────────────────────────
transplant_patients_table <- read_csv(
  "/home/vandana/gender-bias/Treatment_files/transplant_patients_table.csv",
  col_types = cols()
)

# ── 2. Convert date columns ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
transplant_patients_table <- transplant_patients_table %>%
  mutate(
    order_confirmed_date = as.Date(order_confirmed_date),
    last_v_date          = as.Date(last_v_date),
    death_datetime       = ymd_hms(death_datetime, tz = "UTC")
  )

# ── 3. Compute survival info ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
renal_transplant_survival <- transplant_patients_table %>%
  mutate(
    status = if_else(is.na(death_datetime), 0, 1),
    end_date = if_else(is.na(death_datetime),
                       as.POSIXct(last_v_date),
                       death_datetime),
    years_survived = as.numeric(difftime(end_date, order_confirmed_date, units = "days")) / 365.25
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(order_confirmed_date), years_survived >= 0) %>%
  mutate(
    p_gender = tolower(p_gender),
    p_gender = factor(p_gender, levels = c("male", "female"))
  )

# ── 4. Create survival object and fit ────────────────────────────────────────
surv_obj_tx <- Surv(time = renal_transplant_survival$years_survived, 
                    event = renal_transplant_survival$status)
km_fit_tx <- survfit(surv_obj_tx ~ p_gender, data = renal_transplant_survival)

# ── 5. Plot KM curve with number at risk every 2 years ──────────────────────
ggsurvplot(
  km_fit_tx,
  data = renal_transplant_survival,
  risk.table = TRUE,
  break.time.by = 2,
  xlim = c(0, 16),
  pval = TRUE,
  conf.int = TRUE,
  xlab = "Years Survived (from Transplant Date)",
  ylab = "Survival Probability",
  title = "Kaplan–Meier Survival Curve by Gender\nRenal Transplant Recipients",
  palette = c("cyan", "orange"),
  risk.table.height = 0.25,
  fontsize = 3,
  line.size = 0.3,
  linetype = "dotted",
  ggtheme = theme_minimal(base_size = 10),
  legend = "top"
)

```

```{r Kaplan Meier for districts for transplant, fig.cap= "Kaplan_meier_district"}
    order_confirmed_date = as.Date(order_confirmed_date),
    last_v_date          = as.Date(last_v_date),
    death_datetime       = ymd_hms(death_datetime, tz = "UTC")
  )

# ── 5. Build survival data frame ───────────────────────────────────────────
surv_top5 <- transplant_top5 %>%
  mutate(
    status = if_else(is.na(death_datetime), 0, 1),
    end_date = if_else(is.na(death_datetime),
                       as.POSIXct(last_v_date),
                       death_datetime),
    years_survived = as.numeric(difftime(end_date, order_confirmed_date,
                                         units = "days")) / 365.25,
    final_district = factor(final_district)   # keep districts as factor
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(order_confirmed_date), years_survived >= 0)


# ── 6. One KM plot per top‑5 district ─────────────────────────────────────
library(purrr)      # for map()
library(stringr)    # nice labels

top_districts <- levels(surv_top5$final_district)   # exactly 5 levels

km_plots <- map(top_districts, function(dstr) {
  data_d <- surv_top5 %>% filter(final_district == dstr)

  fit_d <- survfit(Surv(years_survived, status) ~ 1, data = data_d)

  ggsurvplot(
    fit_d,
    data            = data_d,
    risk.table      = TRUE,
    conf.int        = TRUE,
    break.time.by   = 2,
    xlim            = c(0, 16),
    xlab            = "Years Survived (from Transplant Date)",
    ylab            = "Survival Probability",
    title           = str_c("Kaplan–Meier Curve – ", dstr),
    palette         = brewer.pal(5, "Set1")[which(top_districts == dstr)],
    risk.table.height = 0.25,
    ggtheme         = theme_minimal(),
    fontsize        = 3,
    line.size       = 0.5
  )
})

names(km_plots) <- top_districts   # so you can reference by district name

# ── 6c. Print or save ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# To display all in sequence:
walk(km_plots, print)

# To save each as PNG:
# walk2(km_plots, names(km_plots), ~ ggsave(paste0("KM_", .y, ".png"), plot = .x$plot, dpi = 300, width = 6, height = 4))

```

```{r}
# ── Libraries ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(stringi)
library(tools)          # toTitleCase()
library(lubridate)      # year()

# ── File paths ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
main_file   <- "/home/vandana/gender-bias/Treatment_files/p_id_services_with_location_dates.csv"
corr_file   <- "/home/vandana/gender-bias/Treatment_files/Corrected_districts_Sheet_new.csv"
census_file <- "/home/vandana/gender-bias/india-districts-census-2011.csv"
out_file    <- "/home/vandana/gender-bias/Treatment_files/p_id_services_with_location_dates_2011.csv"

# ── Helper: standardise names (lower‑case, trim, rm. punctuation, de‑accent) ─
standardise_name <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    str_to_lower() %>%
    str_squish() %>%
    str_replace_all("[^[:alnum:] ]", "") %>%
    stri_trans_general("Latin-ASCII")
}

# 1. READ INPUT FILES ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df_main <- read_csv(main_file, col_types = cols()) %>%
  mutate(order_confirmed_date = as.Date(earliest_order_confirmed_date))

df_corr <- read_csv(corr_file, col_types = cols(
  final_state        = col_character(),
  final_district     = col_character(),
  match_flag         = col_character(),
  Corrected_state    = col_character(),
  Corrected_district = col_character()
)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Corrected_state) & !is.na(Corrected_district))

df_census <- read_csv(census_file, col_types = cols())

# 2. KEEP ONLY 2011 DATA & VALID GENDERS ─────────────────────────────────────
df_main <- df_main %>%
  filter(year(order_confirmed_date) == 2011,
         p_gender != "Unknown") %>%
  mutate(
    final_state    = str_trim(str_to_lower(final_state)),
    final_district = str_trim(str_to_lower(final_district))
  ) %>%
  mutate(                       # hard‑coded fixes (unchanged from your script)
    final_district = case_when(
      final_district == "amethi"        ~ "faizabad",
      final_district == "maharajganj"   ~ "mahrajganj",
      final_district == "lucknow bihar" ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE                              ~ final_district
    ),
    final_state = case_when(
      final_state == "lucknow bihar"    ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE                              ~ final_state
    )
  )

# 3. CLEAN CORRECTION SHEET (same as before) ────────────────────────────────
df_corr <- df_corr %>%
  mutate(across(c(final_state, final_district,
                  Corrected_state, Corrected_district),
                ~ str_trim(str_to_lower(.x)))) %>%
  mutate(
    Corrected_district = case_when(
      Corrected_district == "barabanki"       ~ "bara banki",
      Corrected_district == "raebareli"       ~ "rae bareli",
      Corrected_district == "kanpur"          ~ "kanpur nagar",
      Corrected_district == "kansganj"        ~ "etah",
      Corrected_district == "amethi"          ~ "faizabad",
      Corrected_district == "lakhimpur kheri" ~ "kheri",
      Corrected_district == "harthras"        ~ "aligarh",
      TRUE                                    ~ Corrected_district
    ),
    Corrected_state = case_when(
      Corrected_state == "odisha"       ~ "orissa",
      Corrected_state == "uttaranchal"  ~ "uttarakhand",
      TRUE                              ~ Corrected_state
    )
  )

# 4. APPLY CORRECTIONS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df_fixed <- df_main %>%
  left_join(df_corr, by = c("final_state", "final_district")) %>%
  mutate(
    final_state    = coalesce(Corrected_state,    final_state),
    final_district = coalesce(Corrected_district, final_district)
  ) %>%
  select(-match_flag, -Corrected_state, -Corrected_district) %>%
  mutate(
    final_state    = toTitleCase(final_state),
    final_district = toTitleCase(final_district)
  )

# 5. BUILD CLEAN CENSUS LOOK‑UP TABLE ────────────────────────────────────────
census_key <- df_census %>%
  rename(state_raw = `State name`,
         district_raw = `District name`) %>%
  mutate(
    std_state    = standardise_name(state_raw),
    std_district = standardise_name(district_raw)
  ) %>%
  distinct(std_state, std_district) %>%
  mutate(in_census = TRUE)

# 6. DROP ROWS WHOSE DISTRICTS ARE NOT IN 2011 CENSUS ───────────────────────
df_final_2011 <- df_fixed %>%
  mutate(
    std_state    = standardise_name(final_state),
    std_district = standardise_name(final_district)
  ) %>%
  left_join(census_key,
            by = c("std_state", "std_district")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(in_census)) %>%
  select(-std_state, -std_district, -in_census)

# 7. SAVE RESULT ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
write_csv(df_final_2011, out_file)
cat("✅ 2011‑filtered, census‑matched dataset written to:\n", out_file, "\n")


```

```{r}
# ── Libraries ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(geosphere)

# ── Parameters / file paths ────────────────────────────────────────────────
patient_file   <- "/home/vandana/gender-bias/Treatment_files/p_id_services_with_location_dates_2011.csv"
census_file    <- "/home/vandana/gender-bias/india-districts-census-2011.csv"
centroid_file  <- "/home/vandana/gender-bias/district_wise_centroids.csv"
merged_out     <- "/home/vandana/gender-bias/Treatment_files/districts_80_with_census_2011.csv"

# ── Helper: simple name standardiser ───────────────────────────────────────
standardise <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    str_to_lower() %>% str_trim() %>%
    str_replace_all("[[:punct:]]", "") %>%
    str_replace_all("\\s+", " ")
}

# ── STEP 1: Load 2011 patient data & count patients by district ────────────
patients_2011 <- read_csv(patient_file, col_types = cols()) %>%
  mutate(
    final_state    = standardise(final_state),
    final_district = standardise(final_district),
    p_gender       = standardise(p_gender)
  )

district_counts <- patients_2011 %>%
  group_by(final_state, final_district) %>%
  summarise(
    male_patients   = n_distinct(patient_id[p_gender == "male"]),
    female_patients = n_distinct(patient_id[p_gender == "female"]),
    patients        = male_patients + female_patients,
    .groups         = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(patients)) %>%
  mutate(
    perc     = patients / sum(patients),
    cum_perc = cumsum(perc)
  )

# ── STEP 2: Keep districts that cumulatively cover top 80 % of patients ───
districts_80 <- district_counts %>% filter(cum_perc <= 0.80)


# ── STEP 3: Load census 2011 & standardise names ───────────────────────────
census_data <- read_csv(census_file, col_types = cols()) %>%
  rename(final_state = `State name`,
         final_district = `District name`) %>%
  mutate(
    final_state    = standardise(final_state),
    final_district = standardise(final_district)
  )

# columns to pull
census_vars <- c(
  "Population", "Male", "Female", "Literate", "Male_Literate", "Female_Literate",
  "Workers", "Male_Workers", "Female_Workers", "Household_Workers",
  "LPG_or_PNG_Households", "Housholds_with_Electric_Lighting",
  "Households_with_Internet", "Households_with_Computer",
  "Rural_Households", "Urban_Households", "Secondary_Education",
  "Graduate_Education", "Power_Parity_Rs_90000_150000",
  "Power_Parity_Rs_150000_330000", "Power_Parity_Rs_330000_545000"
)

census_sel <- census_data %>%
  select(final_state, final_district, all_of(census_vars))

# ── STEP 4: Merge top‑80 districts with census data ────────────────────────
merged <- districts_80 %>%
  left_join(census_sel, by = c("final_state", "final_district"))

# ── STEP 5: Attach centroid coordinates & compute distance to Lucknow ─────
centroids <- read_csv(centroid_file, col_types = cols()) %>%
  mutate(
    join_state    = standardise(State),
    join_district = standardise(District)
  )

merged_key <- merged %>%
  mutate(
    join_state    = final_state,
    join_district = if_else(final_district == "kanpur nagar", "kanpur", final_district)
  )

lucknow_coords <- c(lon = 80.89706, lat = 26.838234)   # (E, N)

merged_dist <- merged_key %>%
  left_join(centroids %>% select(join_state, join_district, Latitude, Longitude),
            by = c("join_state", "join_district")) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    Distance_km = ifelse(!is.na(Latitude) & !is.na(Longitude),
                         distHaversine(c(Longitude, Latitude), lucknow_coords) / 1000,
                         NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Distance_km = round(Distance_km, 2)) %>%
  select(-join_state, -join_district)

# ── STEP 6: Save final file ────────────────────────────────────────────────
write_csv(merged_dist, merged_out)
cat("✅ Final merged file with male/female counts saved →", merged_out, "\n")
```

```{r female patient vs education spearman coor 2011, fig.cap= "female patient vs education spearman coor 2011" }


library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(readr)

# ── 1. Load the census‑enhanced, gender‑split dataset (2011) ───────────────
districts_data <- read_csv(
  "/home/vandana/gender-bias/Treatment_files/districts_80_with_census_2011.csv"
)

# ── 2. Build the composite score (Female literacy, workforce, census Female) ─
female_score_data <- districts_data %>%
  transmute(
    final_district,
    female_patients = female_patients,   # <- matches new lowercase field
    composite_score = rowMeans(
      cbind(
        scale(Female_Literate, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE),
        scale(Female_Workers,  center = TRUE, scale = TRUE),
        scale(Female,          center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)
      ),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )

# ── 3. Spearman correlation ────────────────────────────────────────────────
rho <- cor(
  female_score_data$composite_score,
  female_score_data$female_patients,
  method = "spearman",
  use = "complete.obs"
)
rho_label <- paste0("Spearman ρ = ", round(rho, 2))


# ── build & show plot ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ggplot(female_score_data,
       aes(x = composite_score, y = female_patients)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7, colour = "#0072B2") +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = final_district), size = 3, max.overlaps = Inf) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = max(female_score_data$composite_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    y = max(female_score_data$female_patients,  na.rm = TRUE),
    label = rho_label,
    hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.1,
    size  = 4, fontface = "italic"
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Female Education Composite Score(census 2011) vs Female Patient Count(2011)",
    subtitle = "Composite = avg(z) of Female Literacy, Workforce Participation, and Census Female population",
    x        = "Composite Score (Z‑scaled)",
    y        = "Female Patient Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
```

```{r}
# Combined R Script for 2015 Census and Top Districts Analysis

# ── Libraries ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(stringi)
library(tools)
library(lubridate)
library(geosphere)

# ── File Paths ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
main_file     <- "/home/vandana/gender-bias/Treatment_files/p_id_services_with_location_dates.csv"
corr_file     <- "/home/vandana/gender-bias/Treatment_files/Corrected_districts_Sheet_new.csv"
census_file   <- "/home/vandana/gender-bias/india-districts-census-2011.csv"
out_file      <- "/home/vandana/gender-bias/Treatment_files/p_id_services_with_location_dates_2015.csv"
census_2015   <- "/home/vandana/gender-bias/gemini_output/Census_2015.csv"
centroid_file <- "/home/vandana/gender-bias/district_wise_centroids.csv"
merged_out    <- "/home/vandana/gender-bias/Treatment_files/districts_80_with_census_2015.csv"

# ── Helper Functions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
standardise_name <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    str_to_lower() %>%
    str_squish() %>%
    str_replace_all("[^[:alnum:] ]", "") %>%
    stri_trans_general("Latin-ASCII")
}

standardise <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    str_to_lower() %>% str_trim() %>%
    str_replace_all("^\\d+\\s*-\\s*", "") %>%
    str_replace_all("[[:punct:]]", "") %>%
    str_replace_all("\\s+", " ")
}

# ── STEP 1: Load and filter patient data ───────────────────────────────────
df_main <- read_csv(main_file, col_types = cols()) %>%
  mutate(earliest_order_confirmed_date = as.Date(earliest_order_confirmed_date)) %>%
  filter(year(earliest_order_confirmed_date) == 2015, p_gender != "Unknown") %>%
  mutate(
    final_state    = str_trim(str_to_lower(final_state)),
    final_district = str_trim(str_to_lower(final_district)),
    final_district = case_when(
      final_district == "amethi"        ~ "faizabad",
      final_district == "maharajganj"   ~ "mahrajganj",
      final_district == "lucknow bihar" ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE                              ~ final_district
    ),
    final_state = case_when(
      final_state == "lucknow bihar" ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE                           ~ final_state
    )
  )

# ── STEP 2: Load and apply district corrections ────────────────────────────
df_corr <- read_csv(corr_file, col_types = cols()) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Corrected_state) & !is.na(Corrected_district)) %>%
  mutate(across(c(final_state, final_district, Corrected_state, Corrected_district), ~ str_trim(str_to_lower(.)))) %>%
  mutate(
    Corrected_district = case_when(
      Corrected_district == "barabanki"       ~ "bara banki",
      Corrected_district == "raebareli"       ~ "rae bareli",
      Corrected_district == "kanpur"          ~ "kanpur nagar",
      Corrected_district == "kansganj"        ~ "etah",
      Corrected_district == "amethi"          ~ "faizabad",
      Corrected_district == "lakhimpur kheri" ~ "kheri",
      Corrected_district == "harthras"        ~ "aligarh",
      TRUE                                     ~ Corrected_district
    ),
    Corrected_state = case_when(
      Corrected_state == "odisha"      ~ "orissa",
      Corrected_state == "uttaranchal" ~ "uttarakhand",
      TRUE                             ~ Corrected_state
    )
  )

# ── STEP 3: Apply corrections ──────────────────────────────────────────────
df_fixed <- df_main %>%
  left_join(df_corr, by = c("final_state", "final_district")) %>%
  mutate(
    final_state    = coalesce(Corrected_state, final_state),
    final_district = coalesce(Corrected_district, final_district)
  ) %>%
  select(-match_flag, -Corrected_state, -Corrected_district) %>%
  mutate(
    final_state    = toTitleCase(final_state),
    final_district = toTitleCase(final_district)
  )

# ── STEP 4: Match with Census 2011 ─────────────────────────────────────────
df_census <- read_csv(census_file, col_types = cols())
census_key <- df_census %>%
  rename(state_raw = `State name`, district_raw = `District name`) %>%
  mutate(
    std_state    = standardise_name(state_raw),
    std_district = standardise_name(district_raw)
  ) %>%
  distinct(std_state, std_district) %>%
  mutate(in_census = TRUE)

df_final_2011 <- df_fixed %>%
  mutate(
    std_state    = standardise_name(final_state),
    std_district = standardise_name(final_district)
  ) %>%
  left_join(census_key, by = c("std_state", "std_district")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(in_census)) %>%
  select(-std_state, -std_district, -in_census)

write_csv(df_final_2011, out_file)
cat("2015 filtered, census-matched dataset written to:\n", out_file, "\n")

# ── STEP 5: District-level gender counts ───────────────────────────────────
patients_2015 <- df_final_2011 %>%
  mutate(
    final_district = standardise(final_district),
    p_gender       = standardise(p_gender)
  )

district_counts <- patients_2015 %>%
  group_by(final_district) %>%
  summarise(
    male_patients   = n_distinct(patient_id[p_gender == "male"]),
    female_patients = n_distinct(patient_id[p_gender == "female"]),
    patients        = male_patients + female_patients,
    .groups         = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(patients)) %>%
  mutate(
    perc     = patients / sum(patients),
    cum_perc = cumsum(perc)
  )

districts_80 <- district_counts %>% filter(cum_perc <= 0.80)


# ── STEP 6: Merge with 2015 Census Data ────────────────────────────────────
Census_2015 <- read_csv(census_2015, col_types = cols())
colnames(Census_2015) <- colnames(Census_2015) %>%
  str_replace_all("\\s*\\n\\s*", " ") %>%
  str_replace_all("\\.+", "") %>%
  str_squish()

Census_2015 <- Census_2015 %>%
  rename(district_raw = Districts) %>%
  mutate(final_district = standardise(district_raw))

merged <- districts_80 %>%
  left_join(Census_2015 %>% select(-district_raw), by = "final_district")

# ── STEP 7: Add distances to Lucknow ───────────────────────────────────────
centroids <- read_csv(centroid_file, col_types = cols()) %>%
  mutate(join_district = standardise(District))

merged_key <- merged %>%
  mutate(join_district = if_else(final_district == "kanpur nagar", "kanpur", final_district))

lucknow_coords <- c(lon = 80.89706, lat = 26.838234)

merged_dist <- merged_key %>%
  left_join(centroids %>% select(join_district, Latitude, Longitude), by = "join_district") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    Distance_km = ifelse(!is.na(Latitude) & !is.na(Longitude),
                         distHaversine(c(Longitude, Latitude), lucknow_coords) / 1000,
                         NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Distance_km = round(Distance_km, 2)) %>%
  select(-join_district)

# ── STEP 8: Save final merged file ─────────────────────────────────────────
write_csv(merged_dist, merged_out)
cat("✅ Final merged file with census + distance saved →", merged_out, "\n")
```
