```{r UP_socio_economic_2015, fig.cap= "UP_socio_economic_2015_patient_correlation" }
  "Per capita electricity consumption(KWH)",
  "Percentage of electricity consumption in Agriculture sector to total consumption",
  "Percentage of electricity consumption in industry to total consumption",
  "Percentage of domestic electricity consumption to total consumption",
  "Percentage of electrified villages to total inhbited villages",
  "Noof LPGconsumers per lakh of population",
  "No of mobile connections per lakh of population (BSNL)",
  "No of post offices per lakh of population"
)

economic_vars <- c(
  "No of Industrial areas per lakh of population",
  "No of small scale industries per lakh population",
  "Per capita gross value of industrial production(Rs)",
  "No of registered working factories per lakh of population",
  "Credit deposit ratio",
  "No of scheduled commercial banks per lakh of population",
  "Credits(Rs",
  "Deposits(Rs"
)

# ── Dropout correction (reverse sign as lower is better) ───────────────────
districts_data <- districts_data %>%
  mutate(
    `Drop out rate (JBS)`  = -`Drop out rate (JBS)`,
    `Drop out rate(SBS)`   = -`Drop out rate(SBS)`
  )

# ── Function to calculate composite + plot ─────────────────────────────────
make_composite_plot <- function(df, vars, label, color = "#0072B2") {
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(composite_score = rowMeans(scale(select(., all_of(vars))), na.rm = TRUE))
  
  rho <- cor(df$composite_score, df$female_patients, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
  rho_label <- paste0("Spearman ρ = ", round(rho, 2))
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = composite_score, y = female_patients)) +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7, colour = color) +
    geom_text_repel(aes(label = final_district), size = 3, max.overlaps = Inf) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = max(df$composite_score, na.rm = TRUE),
      y = max(df$female_patients, na.rm = TRUE),
      label = rho_label,
      hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.1,
      size = 4, fontface = "italic"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste(label, "Composite Score vs Female Patient Count"),
      subtitle = "Based on census 2015 indicators",
      x = paste(label, "Composite Score (Z‑scaled)"),
      y = "Female Patient Count"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
  
  return(p)
}

# ── Generate and print plots ───────────────────────────────────────────────
health_plot   <- make_composite_plot(districts_data, health_vars, "Health", "#D55E00")
education_plot<- make_composite_plot(districts_data, education_vars, "Education", "#009E73")
infra_plot    <- make_composite_plot(districts_data, infra_vars, "Infrastructure", "#E69F00")
resource_plot <- make_composite_plot(districts_data, resource_vars, "Resource Access", "#56B4E9")
economic_plot <- make_composite_plot(districts_data, economic_vars, "Economic Growth", "#CC79A7")

# View plots (they will show one by one in RStudio)
print(health_plot)
print(education_plot)
print(infra_plot)
print(resource_plot)
print(economic_plot)

```

```{r}
#Plot without Lucknow
# ── Libraries ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(geosphere)

# ── File Paths ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
patient_file   <- "/home/vandana/gender-bias/Treatment_files/p_id_services_with_location_dates_2015.csv"
census_file    <- "/home/vandana/gender-bias/gemini_output/Census_2015.csv"
centroid_file  <- "/home/vandana/gender-bias/district_wise_centroids.csv"
merged_out     <- "/home/vandana/gender-bias/Treatment_files/districts_80_with_census_2015_without_lucknow.csv"

# ── Helper: Standardize names ──────────────────────────────────────────────
standardise <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    str_to_lower() %>% str_trim() %>%
    str_replace_all("^\\d+\\s*-\\s*", "") %>%  # Remove leading "1- " or "2-"
    str_replace_all("[[:punct:]]", "") %>%
    str_replace_all("\\s+", " ")
}

# ── STEP 1: Load patient data & compute district-wise counts ───────────────
patients_2015 <- read_csv(patient_file, col_types = cols()) %>%
  mutate(
    final_district = standardise(final_district),
    p_gender       = standardise(p_gender)
  )

district_counts <- patients_2015 %>%
  group_by(final_district) %>%
  summarise(
    male_patients   = n_distinct(patient_id[p_gender == "male"]),
    female_patients = n_distinct(patient_id[p_gender == "female"]),
    patients        = male_patients + female_patients,
    .groups         = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(patients)) %>%
  mutate(
    perc     = patients / sum(patients),
    cum_perc = cumsum(perc)
  )

# ── STEP 2: Keep top 80% districts ─────────────────────────────────────────
districts_80 <- district_counts %>%
  filter(final_district != "lucknow") %>%           # Exclude Lucknow
  arrange(desc(patients)) %>%
  mutate(
    perc     = patients / sum(patients),
    cum_perc = cumsum(perc)
  ) %>%
  filter(cum_perc <= 0.80)

# ── STEP 3: Load Census 2015 & clean column names and district names ───────
Census_2015 <- read_csv(census_file, col_types = cols())

# Clean column names
colnames(Census_2015) <- colnames(Census_2015) %>%
  str_replace_all("\\s*\\n\\s*", " ") %>%  # Remove newlines
  str_replace_all("\\.+", "") %>%          # Remove dots
  str_squish()                             # Trim extra spaces

# Clean district names
Census_2015 <- Census_2015 %>%
  rename(district_raw = Districts) %>%
  mutate(final_district = standardise(district_raw))

# ── STEP 4: Merge top-80 districts with census data ────────────────────────
merged <- districts_80 %>%
  left_join(Census_2015 %>% select(-district_raw), by = "final_district")

# ── STEP 5: Add centroid coordinates & compute distance to Lucknow ────────
centroids <- read_csv(centroid_file, col_types = cols()) %>%
  mutate(join_district = standardise(District))

merged_key <- merged %>%
  mutate(
    join_district = if_else(final_district == "kanpur nagar", "kanpur", final_district)
  )

lucknow_coords <- c(lon = 80.89706, lat = 26.838234)

merged_dist <- merged_key %>%
  left_join(centroids %>% select(join_district, Latitude, Longitude),
            by = "join_district") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    Distance_km = ifelse(!is.na(Latitude) & !is.na(Longitude),
                         distHaversine(c(Longitude, Latitude), lucknow_coords) / 1000,
                         NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Distance_km = round(Distance_km, 2)) %>%
  select(-join_district)

# ── STEP 6: Save final merged file ─────────────────────────────────────────
write_csv(merged_dist, merged_out)
cat("Final merged file with census + distance saved →", merged_out, "\n")

```

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(stringi)
library(tools)          # toTitleCase()
library(lubridate)      # year()

# ── File paths ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
main_file   <- "/home/vandana/gender-bias/Treatment_files/p_id_services_with_location_dates.csv"
corr_file   <- "/home/vandana/gender-bias/Treatment_files/Corrected_districts_Sheet_new.csv"
census_file <- "/home/vandana/gender-bias/india-districts-census-2011.csv"
out_file    <- "/home/vandana/gender-bias/Treatment_files/p_id_services_with_location_dates_2016.csv"

# ── Helper: standardise names (lower‑case, trim, rm. punctuation, de‑accent) ─
standardise_name <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    str_to_lower() %>%
    str_squish() %>%
    str_replace_all("[^[:alnum:] ]", "") %>%
    stri_trans_general("Latin-ASCII")
}

# 1. READ INPUT FILES ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df_main <- read_csv(main_file, col_types = cols()) %>%
  mutate(earliest_order_confirmed_date = as.Date(earliest_order_confirmed_date))

df_corr <- read_csv(corr_file, col_types = cols(
  final_state        = col_character(),
  final_district     = col_character(),
  match_flag         = col_character(),
  Corrected_state    = col_character(),
  Corrected_district = col_character()
)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Corrected_state) & !is.na(Corrected_district))

df_census <- read_csv(census_file, col_types = cols())

# 2. KEEP ONLY 2011 DATA & VALID GENDERS ─────────────────────────────────────
df_main <- df_main %>%
  filter(year(earliest_order_confirmed_date) == 2016,
         p_gender != "Unknown") %>%
  mutate(
    final_state    = str_trim(str_to_lower(final_state)),
    final_district = str_trim(str_to_lower(final_district))
  ) %>%
  mutate(                       # hard‑coded fixes (unchanged from your script)
    final_district = case_when(
      final_district == "amethi"        ~ "faizabad",
      final_district == "maharajganj"   ~ "mahrajganj",
      final_district == "lucknow bihar" ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE                              ~ final_district
    ),
    final_state = case_when(
      final_state == "lucknow bihar"    ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE                              ~ final_state
    )
  )

# 3. CLEAN CORRECTION SHEET (same as before) ────────────────────────────────
df_corr <- df_corr %>%
  mutate(across(c(final_state, final_district,
                  Corrected_state, Corrected_district),
                ~ str_trim(str_to_lower(.x)))) %>%
  mutate(
    Corrected_district = case_when(
      Corrected_district == "barabanki"       ~ "bara banki",
      Corrected_district == "raebareli"       ~ "rae bareli",
      Corrected_district == "kanpur"          ~ "kanpur nagar",
      Corrected_district == "kansganj"        ~ "etah",
      Corrected_district == "amethi"          ~ "faizabad",
      Corrected_district == "lakhimpur kheri" ~ "kheri",
      Corrected_district == "harthras"        ~ "aligarh",
      TRUE                                    ~ Corrected_district
    ),
    Corrected_state = case_when(
      Corrected_state == "odisha"       ~ "orissa",
      Corrected_state == "uttaranchal"  ~ "uttarakhand",
      TRUE                              ~ Corrected_state
    )
  )

# 4. APPLY CORRECTIONS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df_fixed <- df_main %>%
  left_join(df_corr, by = c("final_state", "final_district")) %>%
  mutate(
    final_state    = coalesce(Corrected_state,    final_state),
    final_district = coalesce(Corrected_district, final_district)
  ) %>%
  select(-match_flag, -Corrected_state, -Corrected_district) %>%
  mutate(
    final_state    = toTitleCase(final_state),
    final_district = toTitleCase(final_district)
  )

# 5. BUILD CLEAN CENSUS LOOK‑UP TABLE ────────────────────────────────────────
census_key <- df_census %>%
  rename(state_raw = `State name`,
         district_raw = `District name`) %>%
  mutate(
    std_state    = standardise_name(state_raw),
    std_district = standardise_name(district_raw)
  ) %>%
  distinct(std_state, std_district) %>%
  mutate(in_census = TRUE)

# 6. DROP ROWS WHOSE DISTRICTS ARE NOT IN 2011 CENSUS ───────────────────────
df_final_2016 <- df_fixed %>%
  mutate(
    std_state    = standardise_name(final_state),
    std_district = standardise_name(final_district)
  ) %>%
  left_join(census_key,
            by = c("std_state", "std_district")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(in_census)) %>%
  select(-std_state, -std_district, -in_census)

# 7. SAVE RESULT ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
write_csv(df_final_2016, out_file)
cat("✅ 2011‑filtered, census‑matched dataset written to:\n", out_file, "\n")

```

```{r}
# ── Libraries ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(geosphere)

# ── File Paths ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
patient_file   <- "/home/vandana/gender-bias/Treatment_files/p_id_services_with_location_dates_2016.csv"
census_file    <- "/home/vandana/gender-bias/gemini_output/Census_2016.csv"
centroid_file  <- "/home/vandana/gender-bias/district_wise_centroids.csv"
merged_out     <- "/home/vandana/gender-bias/Treatment_files/districts_80_with_census_2016_without_lucknow.csv"

# ── Helper: Standardize names ──────────────────────────────────────────────
standardise <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    str_to_lower() %>% str_trim() %>%
    str_replace_all("^\\d+\\s*-\\s*", "") %>%  # Remove leading "1- " or "2-"
    str_replace_all("[[:punct:]]", "") %>%
    str_replace_all("\\s+", " ")
}

# ── STEP 1: Load patient data & compute district-wise counts ───────────────
patients_2016 <- read_csv(patient_file, col_types = cols()) %>%
  mutate(
    final_district = standardise(final_district),
    p_gender       = standardise(p_gender)
  )

district_counts <- patients_2016 %>%
  group_by(final_district) %>%
  summarise(
    male_patients   = n_distinct(patient_id[p_gender == "male"]),
    female_patients = n_distinct(patient_id[p_gender == "female"]),
    patients        = male_patients + female_patients,
    .groups         = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(patients)) %>%
  mutate(
    perc     = patients / sum(patients),
    cum_perc = cumsum(perc)
  )

# ── STEP 2: Keep top 80% districts ─────────────────────────────────────────
districts_80 <- district_counts %>%
  filter(final_district != "lucknow") %>%           # Exclude Lucknow
  arrange(desc(patients)) %>%
  mutate(
    perc     = patients / sum(patients),
    cum_perc = cumsum(perc)
  ) %>%
  filter(cum_perc <= 0.80)

# ── STEP 3: Load Census 2015 & clean column names and district names ───────
Census_2016 <- read_csv(census_file, col_types = cols())

# Clean column names
colnames(Census_2016) <- colnames(Census_2016) %>%
  str_replace_all("\\s*\\n\\s*", " ") %>%  # Remove newlines
  str_replace_all("\\.+", "") %>%          # Remove dots
  str_squish()                             # Trim extra spaces

# Clean district names
Census_2016 <- Census_2016 %>%
  rename(district_raw = Districts) %>%
  mutate(final_district = standardise(district_raw))

# ── STEP 4: Merge top-80 districts with census data ────────────────────────
merged <- districts_80 %>%
  left_join(Census_2016 %>% select(-district_raw), by = "final_district")

# ── STEP 5: Add centroid coordinates & compute distance to Lucknow ────────
centroids <- read_csv(centroid_file, col_types = cols()) %>%
  mutate(join_district = standardise(District))

merged_key <- merged %>%
  mutate(
    join_district = if_else(final_district == "kanpur nagar", "kanpur", final_district)
  )

lucknow_coords <- c(lon = 80.89706, lat = 26.838234)

merged_dist <- merged_key %>%
  left_join(centroids %>% select(join_district, Latitude, Longitude),
            by = "join_district") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    Distance_km = ifelse(!is.na(Latitude) & !is.na(Longitude),
                         distHaversine(c(Longitude, Latitude), lucknow_coords) / 1000,
                         NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Distance_km = round(Distance_km, 2)) %>%
  select(-join_district)

# ── STEP 6: Save final merged file ─────────────────────────────────────────
write_csv(merged_dist, merged_out)
cat("✅ Final merged file with census + distance saved →", merged_out, "\n")


```


```{r  UP_socio_economic_2015_without_lucknow_correlation, fig.cap= "UP_socio_economic_2015_patient_correlation_without_lucknow"}
# ── Libraries ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(readr)
library(scales)

# ── Load 2016 census-enhanced dataset (without Lucknow) ────────────────────
districts_data <- read_csv("/home/vandana/gender-bias/Treatment_files/districts_80_with_census_2016_without_lucknow.csv")

# ── Define variable groups ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
health_vars <- c(
  "No of Allopathic hospitals/dispensaries per lakh of population(including PHCs",
  "No of beds in Allopathic hospitals/dispensaries per lakh of population(including PHCs",
  "No of PHCs per lakh of population",
  "No of MCH centres/sub centres per lakh of population"
)

education_vars <- c(
  "No of School per lakh of population (JBS)",
  "No of School per lakh of population (SBS)",
  "Pupil teacher ratio at different educational levels (SBS)",
  "Pupil teacher ratio at different educational levels (HSS)",
  "Student Enrolment ratio (JBS)",
  "Student Enrolment ratio (SBS)",
  "Drop out rate (JBS)",
  "Drop out rate(SBS)"
)

infra_vars <- c(
  "Length of PWD Pucca roads per lakh population",
  "Length of PWD Pucca roads per thousand Sq Km",
  "Total length of pucca roads per lakh population",
  "Total length of pucca roads per thousand Sq Km"
)

resource_vars <- c(
  "Per capita electricity consumption(KWH)",
  "Percentage of electricity consumption in Agriculture sector to total consumption",
  "Percentage of electricity consumption in industry to total consumption",
  "Percentage of domestic electricity consumption to total consumption",
  "Percentage of electrified villages to total inhbited villages",
  "Noof LPGconsumers per lakh of population",
  "No of mobile connections per lakh of population (BSNL)",
  "No of post offices per lakh of population"
)

economic_vars <- c(
  "No of Industrial areas per lakh of population",
  "No of small scale industries per lakh population",
  "Per capita gross value of industrial production(Rs)",
  "No of registered working factories per lakh of population",
  "Credit deposit ratio",
  "No of scheduled commercial banks per lakh of population",
  "Credits(Rs",
  "Deposits(Rs"
)

# ── Dropout correction (reverse sign as lower is better) ───────────────────
districts_data <- districts_data %>%
  mutate(
    `Drop out rate (JBS)`  = -`Drop out rate (JBS)`,
    `Drop out rate(SBS)`   = -`Drop out rate(SBS)`
  )

# ── Function to calculate composite score and plot ─────────────────────────
make_composite_plot <- function(df, vars, label, color = "#0072B2") {
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(composite_score = rowMeans(scale(select(., all_of(vars))), na.rm = TRUE))
  
  rho <- cor(df$composite_score, df$female_patients, method = "pearson", use = "complete.obs")
  rho_label <- paste0("Pearson ρ = ", round(rho, 2))
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = composite_score, y = female_patients)) +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7, colour = color) +
    geom_text_repel(aes(label = final_district), size = 3, max.overlaps = Inf) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = max(df$composite_score, na.rm = TRUE),
      y = max(df$female_patients, na.rm = TRUE),
      label = rho_label,
      hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.1,
      size = 4, fontface = "italic"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste(label, "Composite Score vs Female Patient Count"),
      subtitle = "Based on census 2016 indicators",
      x = paste(label, "Composite Score (Z‑scaled)"),
      y = "Female Patient Count"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
  
  return(p)
}

# ── Generate and print plots (without Lucknow) ─────────────────────────────
health_plot_without_lucknow    <- make_composite_plot(districts_data, health_vars, "Health", "#D55E00")
education_plot_without_lucknow <- make_composite_plot(districts_data, education_vars, "Education", "#009E73")
infra_plot_without_lucknow     <- make_composite_plot(districts_data, infra_vars, "Infrastructure", "#E69F00")
resource_plot_without_lucknow  <- make_composite_plot(districts_data, resource_vars, "Resource Access", "#56B4E9")
economic_plot_without_lucknow  <- make_composite_plot(districts_data, economic_vars, "Economic Growth", "#CC79A7")

# ── Print Plots ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
print(health_plot_without_lucknow)
print(education_plot_without_lucknow)
print(infra_plot_without_lucknow)
print(resource_plot_without_lucknow)
print(economic_plot_without_lucknow)

```

```{r UP_socio_economic_2015_without_composite_score, fig.cap= "UP_socio_economic_2015_patient_correlation_without_composite_score"}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(ggrepel)
library(rlang)  # for sym()

# Step 1: Load data
districts <- read_csv("/home/vandana/gender-bias/Treatment_files/districts_80_with_census_2015_without_lucknow.csv")

# Step 2: Add raw female-to-male ratio (no log)
districts <- districts %>%
  mutate(female_to_male_ratio = female_patients / male_patients)

# Step 3: Define predictor variables
predictor_vars <- c(
  "No of Allopathic hospitals/dispensaries per lakh of population(including PHCs",
  "No of beds in Allopathic hospitals/dispensaries per lakh of population(including PHCs",
  "No of PHCs per lakh of population",
  "No of MCH centres/sub centres per lakh of population",
  "No of School per lakh of population (JBS)",
  "No of School per lakh of population (SBS)",
  "Drop out rate (JBS)",
  "Drop out rate(SBS)",
  "Per capita electricity consumption(KWH)",
  "Noof LPGconsumers per lakh of population",
  "No of mobile connections per lakh of population (BSNL)",
  "No of scheduled commercial banks per lakh of population",
  "No of registered working factories per lakh of population"
)

# Step 4: Calculate pearson correlations
cor_values <- lapply(predictor_vars, function(var) {
  cor_val <- cor(districts$female_to_male_ratio, districts[[var]], method = "pearson", use = "complete.obs")
  data.frame(Predictor = var, Correlation = round(cor_val, 2))
}) %>% bind_rows()

# Step 5: Generate individual plots
for (var in predictor_vars) {
  correlation <- cor_values %>% filter(Predictor == var) %>% pull(Correlation)
  
  p <- ggplot(districts, aes(x = !!sym(var), y = female_to_male_ratio, label = final_district)) +
    geom_point(color = "darkblue", alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_text_repel(size = 2.5, max.overlaps = 20) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Female-to-Male Patient Ratio vs", var),
      subtitle = paste("pearson r =", correlation),
      x = var,
      y = "Female / Male Patient Ratio"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
  
  print(p)
}


```
